title: Dar es Salaam: A Stopover Guide
excerpt: Dar es Salaam is Tanzania's largest city and a gateway to the south and Zanzibar. What to do on a stopover.
body:
## The city

Dar es Salaam ("haven of peace") is a fast-growing port city and Tanzania's commercial centre.

## What to do

- National Museum.
- Kariakoo Market (busy, go with a guide).
- The fish market at Kivukoni.
- Tingatinga art. See [Tingatinga](/blog/tingatinga-painting-workshop/).
- Coco Beach and the Msasani peninsula.
- Day trip to [Bagamoyo](/blog/bagamoyo-history/).

## Traffic

Traffic can be heavy. Plan time for airport transfers.

## Onward

[Ferry to Zanzibar](/blog/ferry-dar-es-salaam-zanzibar/), flights to the southern parks.

Read our [Dar es Salaam page](/national-parks/dar-es-salaam/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
